description: Campaign assets for service 2 (engine service-integration item 9). Campaigns starts it as a subflow with 1 channel brief, campaign_id and markets. Runs influencer.plan (strategy, plan gate, discovery, vetting, shortlist gate) and registers the approved plan. The run finishes with output.artifact_ids. Creator posts come later through influencer.recruit and influencer.deliver, each with its own contract and content gates; post dates sit inside the campaign flight, after svc.campaigns/market.launched.

channel_brief.description: Part 3 of the campaigns master brief, for the influencer channel

steps.name: Plan, discover, vet and shortlist creators from the channel brief
Register the approved plan and shortlist with campaign_id
Report the artifact_ids with campaign_id to campaigns
